subject: Approval request: signing package exception for Staff Inference Engineer candidate
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@evolve-search.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + comp ask for Oliver Grant (Staff Inference Engineer)

Hi Maya / Laura,

Quick intro: Oliver Grant is the candidate we screened last week — ex-infra at Meridian AI, led inference optimizations at scale, outstanding on latency/value tradeoffs. He had a final loop with Maya yesterday and is excited to join Redwood.

Role: Staff Inference Engineer (team: Serving Runtime)
Comp band: Band 7 (staff) — market midpoint here is $210k base + equity band 0.3-0.5%.

As discussed with the panel, Oliver is requesting a signing package above the standard band: a $65,000 signing bonus (to bridge relocation/family timing) and a one-time equity refresh of 0.6% on top of the standard grant. He is also asking for a 60-day window to finalize personal logistics.

Attachments: resume + comp-band comparison.

Can you confirm whether we have flexibility to approve an out-of-band signing + equity uplift? If you need more context I can share interview notes. Candidate is targeting an offer this week and will likely accept quickly if terms are competitive.

Thanks,
Sarah
Evolve Search

Attachment stubs: oliver_grant_resume.pdf (47kb), comp-band-comparison.xlsx (12kb)
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@evolve-search.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + comp ask for Oliver Grant (Staff Inference Engineer)

Aditya / Laura — tagging you for comp and HR approval.

Context / ask: After calibrating with the interview panel, Oliver is an above-band hire given rare infra/ops + inference production experience (he built a high-throughput KV cache for a low-latency LLM product). He cleared all loops. To secure him we propose:
- Base: $225,000 (above midpoint; within band ceiling)
- Signing bonus: $65,000 (one-time, paid over first two payrolls)
- Equity: standard grant for Band 7 plus a one-time equity refresh of 0.6% (vested separately over 4 years with 1-yr cliff)
- Target start: July 6, 2026 (flexible)

I recognize the equity uplift is outside the normal cap but the panel believes the long-term value justifies it; this candidate would accelerate our runtime work and reduce time-to-production for several customers. Sarah indicates other offers may come in this window.

Requesting: Aditya — formal approval for the $65k sign-on and 0.6% one-time refresh. Laura — HR to prepare offer draft and confirm DocuSign flow and tax/relocation with Finance.

If you want a short 15-min sync I can jump on it today.

Thanks,
Maya
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@evolve-search.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + comp ask for Oliver Grant (Staff Inference Engineer)

Maya — thanks for the write-up and context.

I approve the one-time signing package as requested with the following conditions:
1) Signing bonus capped at $65,000 and paid equally across first two payrolls; if candidate leaves within 12 months we will recoup on a prorated basis via the standard clawback.
2) Equity refresh approval limited to the one-time 0.6% ROE as a special exception; total dilution must be logged against the executive hiring exception ledger (Finance will adjust).
3) Approval window: this exception is valid through May 28, 2026 — candidate must sign by then unless we re-request.

Laura — please ensure the offer letter captures clawback language and references the exception approval. Maya, please confirm the start date window so we can include appropriate relocation allowance language.

Approving now so we can move quickly but want proper paperwork.

- Aditya
VP, Talent & Comp Planning
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>

All —

Thanks team. Per Aditya's approval, HR has drafted the offer and attached the final documents. Key callouts included in the offer:
- Base salary: $225,000
- Signing bonus: $65,000 (paid across first two payrolls; 12-month prorated clawback)
- One-time equity refresh: 0.6% (separate grant; 4y vest, 1y cliff)
- Start window: Target July 6, 2026; candidate may request up to a 60-day start flexibility

I've uploaded the offer to DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/REDWOOD-OFFER-OLIVER-472 (live link)
Attachment: offer_letter_draft.pdf (finalized; includes clawback and exception reference).

Sarah / Oliver — please review and let me know when you want us to send the DocuSign envelope. Once Oliver signs, Finance will record the exception against the hiring ledger.

Laura Bennett
